verdict.rationale: Pomelo's own guides document blocking specific merchants, merchant categories and merchant IDs, which covers the MCC/merchant blocklist part of the story. Only a one-line guide summary supports it, and nothing shows allowlists or locking a card to a single merchant. Missing for 10: MCC allowlists, single-merchant locks, explicit confirmation that rules apply at authorization time, in-depth configuration docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can restrict where a card works — merchant category (MCC) allowlists and blocklists, and single-merchant locks — applied at authorization time

citations.quote: Protege a tus clientes bloqueando comercios específicos, categorías o IDs de comercio.
